about: Modwerk's Analog Rytm MKII base for OS 1.74, built by npm run machine:base -- analog-rytm-mkii from core-ar2 0.7's source (sdk/imports/core-ar2-source-fb58292.json) and Modwerk's base/ sources. Three variants, each identified by its SHA-256 in sdk/machines/analog-rytm-mkii/base-binding.json: plain (13a1c204, the source with the machine list's sections, the amp envelope's record and the FX track's edit save of words 38 to 41), send-bus (9d2e0667, with the FX track's lock words, the send bus, whose effects work in the mod RAM the set leaves free, the sequencer's time, and the digital voices (mw_voices, ev_sound_applied)) and voices (2f72465c, send-bus without the FX track's lock words, the send bus, its pages, the sequencer's time and the FX list: the digital voices), compiled with GCC's late-combine pass off. The site builds a Rytm set on send-bus when it holds a send effect (sdk/machines/analog-rytm-mkii/fx-ids.json), on voices when it holds a digital voice machine (voice-modules.json) and no send effect, and on plain otherwise. Stock-free: each site names its stock bytes by length and SHA-256, and the build fills them from the owner's OS.
